BiblicalUsage: An evil report is a tale carried to harm a man, and it runs through the Bible from Joseph to Jeremiah. Joseph brings his brothers' evil report to their father, the spies bring an evil report of the land, and the psalmist hears the slander of many who take counsel against him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe an evil report is a weapon, and the Bible shows both its edges. A true report can expose real sin, and a false one can destroy a good name, and the difference is the heart of the one who carries it.
